pages.title: The First Damaging Strike
pages.text: A Fabao-tier or higher weapon binds to the first player who deals actual damage with it. Picking it up, equipping it, charging, or missing does not bind it. A fully blocked hit that deals no damage does not count.

pages.title: A Weapon and Its Owner
pages.text: Once bound, only its owner can use that weapon. Inspect the owner name in its tooltip before wielding a recovered artifact. Passing it to another player or reconnecting does not remove ownership.

pages.title: Lesser Weapons
pages.text: Mortal, Magic, and Spiritual weapons are below this binding threshold. Existing realm, Qi, and handling requirements still apply. Moving a bound artifact to another hand does not change its owner.
